rows.grounds: compound of ūrdhva-bhūmi, agni-bhāga, and eka; indicates a single fire-part measure on the upper story
instrument denoting the means of measurement
object denoting the outward extension or protrusion

items.question: What extent of central projection is prescribed for the upper story by the measuring rod?
premises: The projection is specified as one fire-part of the upper story.
This projection is located in the middle.
The extent is determined by means of the measuring rod.
items.inference: The central projection on the upper story must extend one fire-part as measured by the rod.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of agni-bhāga in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: In the middle, the projection should extend by one fire-part of the upper story, measured by the rod.
